Hi, I'm Sarika, an engineer turned data enthusiast. I grew up in Bangladesh and studied Electrical and Computer Systems Engineering. Before MDS, I spent for three years as an engineer and process analyst before deciding to go all in on data science. Now I'm here to build the technical depth I need to keep doing that work — and do it better.
